description: Use when you do NOT already know the exact state and county. Fuzzy-matches one free-text reference ('Kane', 'Cook County IL', a misspelling, or a 5-digit FIPS code) against every covered county and names each county it matched, so an ambiguous reference comes back as a list to choose from rather than a silent guess. Each match carries that county's technical record, the same record get_parcel_endpoint returns for one county. Call get_parcel_endpoint directly whenever you already hold an exact state and county; come here only to turn a vague, misspelled or coded reference into definite ones.

query.description: County name, 'County Name State' (e.g. 'Kane IL'), or 5-digit FIPS code

name: find_county
title: Resolve an uncertain county reference
